Binary check. PASS only if the answer does BOTH:
1. Names at least four generic SDLC phases (e.g. requirements/planning, design, implementation/development, testing, deployment, maintenance).
2. Contains no pipeline-run artefacts: no dollar cost estimates, no agent names (business-analyst, developer, qa-engineer, …), no model tiers, no dry-run preview.
Otherwise FAIL.
